title: Two levels folded on one readiness object
description: User story under REQ-175. computeReadiness folds levels (intentComplete, readyToBuild) and personas (productOwner, engineer) from stages[].checks[] on every read; nothing new is written. The `rcf define readiness --level intent --json` output at a tree hash is the artefact a delivery stream picks up.
iWant: `rcf define readiness --level intent --json` at a tree hash to be the artefact that says the product owner's part is done
soThat: I can pick a tree up without a hand-over meeting

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given a tree where every productOwner check is ok and at least one engineer check fails, when readiness is computed, then levels.intentComplete.ok is true and levels.readyToBuild.ok is false.
[happy] Given a tree where freezeable is true, when readiness is computed, then levels.readyToBuild.ok is true and levels.intentComplete.ok is true.

[failure] Given a tree where brief:profile fails, when readiness is computed, then levels.intentComplete.ok is false and levels.intentComplete.blockedBy holds one blocker for D1 brief:profile with persona productOwner and ids profile:surface and profile:register.
[happy] Given a D3 stage acknowledged at the current hash with a failing engineer check, when readiness is computed, then that check is absent from levels.readyToBuild.blockedBy.
[happy] Given any tree, when readiness is computed, then personas.productOwner.blockers deep-equals levels.intentComplete.blockedBy and levels.readyToBuild.nextAction deep-equals nextAction.

[happy] Given failing engineer checks in D2 and D4 and a failing productOwner check in D4 only, when readiness is computed, then personas.productOwner.nextAction names D4 and personas.engineer.nextAction names D2.
[must-not] Given any invocation of `rcf define readiness`, when it completes, then no file under rcf/ has been created or modified.

[must-not] Given the 0.28.4 JSON consumer fields (tree, delta, stages, nextAction, coverage, decisions, freezeable), when readiness is emitted under 0.29.0, then every one of them is present with its 0.28.4 type.
